- Files: the Home page is back (it opens on Home again and Back goes there); only the 'Received files' card is gone from it.
- Files: the Search tab of the bottom bar opens the search page of its own (the round floating button is gone).
- Music (Poweramp look): while the now playing sheet is pulled, the Library or Search page under it has its blurred cover background (the one it shows at rest), not plain black.
- Files: the buttons of the picked files stand in the top row next to the menu button, and the path bar stays under them.
- Music, YouTube Music page: History lists only the songs played online (no phone songs, no All / Online / On the phone filter); Suggestions start from the artists the listening log scored highest and put their songs first.
- YouTube (YTX): the About card (version, licence, Up to date) is gone from its settings.
- YouTube (YTX) home: the full-width feed pictures are decoded at 960 x 540 at most and appear without a fade, and the filter of rejected videos runs only when the list changes (not at every redraw): less work while the feed scrolls.
- Keyboard: the password generator, change case, line start and line end tiles are out of the ⋮ menu and the bar again (they stay in the list of Settings > Keyboard > menu).
- YouTube (YTX) home: the last feed is kept on the phone and shows at once at the next start while the new one loads (as Flow's home feed cache); the ranking by taste and the filter of rejected videos run off the main thread, so the list does not stutter while a page arrives; a failed refresh keeps the cards on screen.
- Files: a folder is read in one native Rust pass (kind, size and time with the names; no stat for each file) when the library is there; the Kotlin read stays as the fallback.
- Keyboard: 'Learned words' counts only the words typed three times or more (or added by hand), not every word ever seen (the count stuck near the 8000 kept); the list shows the same words.
- App lock: its polling loops (every 120 and 200 ms for as long as the service lives: about 4% of the processor at rest) sleep a second and a half when no app is locked or the screen is off, and wake at once when the screen comes on.
- Cache cleaner: the scan waits for the root check before it starts (it started before the check had answered, took the phone for one without root and found 0 MB where SD Maid found 4 GB); without root or usage access it says why it sees nothing.
